description.zh:
内网访问应用ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~)：批量查询内网访问应用。
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~)：创建内网访问应用。
description.en:
The ID of the internal access application. You can obtain the application ID by calling the following operations:

*   [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): queries all internal access applications.
*   [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): creates an internal access application.

description.zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000。
description.en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

description.zh: 内网访问标签名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the internal access tag. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

description.zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略。
description.en:
The ID of the internal access policy. You can obtain the policy ID by calling the following operations:

*   [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): queries all internal access policies.
*   [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): creates an internal access policy.

description.zh: 简单查询模式。如果值为true，表示不需要查询PolicyId字段。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the simple query mode. A value of true specifies that policy IDs are not queried.

description.zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问标签ID。
description.en: The IDs of internal access tags. You can specify up to 100 tag IDs.

title.zh: 批量查询内网访问标签

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas list-private-access-tags --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --name tag_name --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --application-id pa-application-e12860ef6c480000 --policy-id pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000 --simple-mode true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas ListPrivateAccessTags --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationId 'pa-application-e12860ef6c480000' --PolicyId 'pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000' --Name tag_name --SimpleMode true --force
